_comment: ERC violations reviewed and accepted. tools/check_erc_baseline.py fails CI only on violations absent from this list. Matched on (type, uuid), so moving a symbol does not invalidate an entry.

accepted.description: Symbol USBC1 Pin A4_B9 [VBUS, Power input, Line]
accepted.reason: VBUS is supplied by the attached USB-C cable. Nothing on this board drives it, by design.

accepted.description: Symbol CN5 Pin 1 [1, Power input, Line]
accepted.reason: The solar/DC input is supplied by an external source through the screw terminal. Nothing on this board drives it, by design.

accepted.description: Symbol U201 Pin 1 [VDD(A), Power input, Line]
accepted.reason: VDD(A) sits on 3V3_USER, confirmed in the netlist. The TPS22918 load switch that feeds that rail does not declare its output as a power-output pin, so ERC cannot see a driver.

accepted.description: Symbol U8 Pin 10 [ACDRV2, Power input, Line]
accepted.reason: ACDRV2 is a gate-driver OUTPUT that drives Q303/Q304. Same symbol defect as ACDRV1.

accepted.description: Symbol U3 Pin 7 [REG25, Power input, Line]
accepted.reason: REG25 is the OUTPUT of the fuel gauge's internal 2.5V LDO. The symbol declares it as a power input, which is a symbol defect.
